### The Conversion of Saul
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-conversion-of-saul
Passage: Acts 9:5a
Points:
- Saul traveled toward Damascus with official authority, consumed by zeal to eradicate followers of Jesus.
- A heavenly light and personal voice from heaven confronted Saul on the road, stopping him in his tracks.
- By asking why Saul persecuted Him, Jesus showed that He intimately identifies with His suffering church.
- Blinding Saul and sending him into Damascus reduced an arrogant enemy to days of blindness, fasting, and prayer.
- God has absolute power over His adversaries and sovereignly directs even seasons of hardship for His church.

### Roadside Conversion - Today's Insight - June 8, 2024
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-june-8-2024.html
Passage: Acts 9:1-2
Points:
- Saul charged toward Damascus with unchecked fury and determination to arrest believers.
- God remained silent during Saul's journey until stepping in at the moment of greatest impact.
- Without advance warning, a sudden flash of heavenly light brought Saul's rampage to a complete halt.
- Sudden, disruptive trials often crash into our lives just as unexpectedly as the light struck Saul.
- Unplanned crises serve to jolt our attention and remind us that God is ultimately in control.
